title: ImageRSI: Verification-Driven Recursive Self-Improvement for Agentic Image Generation
title_zh: ImageRSI：面向智能体图像生成的验证驱动递归自我改进

paragraphs.en: 提出ImageRSI框架，通过验证修复、经验库与判别器离线更新实现图像生成递归自我改进，并发布ImageReq-Bench基准。 Complex text-to-image requests remain difficult to satisfy reliably. Verifying and repairing an image can fix an individual output, but a successful repair does not necessarily carry over to other requests. We present ImageRSI, a framework that keeps the image generator frozen and combines three components: five-dimensional verification and repair within each task, an experience library shared across tasks, and offline updating of the judge. Candidate experiences enter the library only after paired A/B validation, and the judge is updated with supervised fine-tuning and GRPO on accumulated image-judgment records and evaluated before reuse. We also introduce ImageReq-Bench, a benchmark of 961 requests built around hard cases in real-world image-generation requests, each paired with an evaluation checklist. ImageRSI achieves a Checklist Strict Accuracy (CSA) of 52.6% on MindBench (with Nano Banana Pro as the generator) and 65.66% on ImageReq-Bench, and we compare system outcomes across judge-training configurations.
paragraphs.zh: 提出ImageRSI框架，通过验证修复、经验库与判别器离线更新实现图像生成递归自我改进，并发布ImageReq-Bench基准。复杂的文本到图像请求仍然难以被可靠地满足。 对图像进行验证与修复可以修正单个输出，但一次成功的修复并不一定能迁移到其他请求上。 我们提出ImageRSI，这是一个保持图像生成器冻结的框架，它结合了三个组件：任务内部的五维验证与修复、跨任务共享的经验库，以及判别器的离线更新。 候选经验只有在经过成对A/B验证后才会进入经验库，判别器则基于积累的图像评判记录，通过监督微调和GRPO进行更新，并在复用前接受评估。 我们还介绍了ImageReq-Bench，这是一个包含961条请求的基准，围绕真实世界图像生成请求中的困难案例构建，每条请求都配有评估清单。 ImageRSI在MindBench上取得了52.6%的清单严格准确率（CSA）（以Nano Banana Pro作为生成器），在ImageReq-Bench上取得了65.66%，并且我们比较了不同判别器训练配置下的系统表现。
